_meta.note: Generated by tools/seed/fetch_images.py. One entry per distinct image address in the seed. `file` names a copy under public/seed-images; an entry with no `file` carries the measured reason the picture could not be obtained, and the app keeps showing its address instead. An entry with `via`: `mpf-mirror` was taken off the dealership's own mirror of THAT SAME ADDRESS rather than off the host, because the host refuses us; `mirror` names the object and `mirrorKey` is sha1(url)[:16], which is how the object was addressed. Nothing is matched by resemblance and nothing is substituted.
